CustomObject.description: The Log Event platform event publishes rollback-safe telemetry, breadcrumbs, and exceptions from Apex, Flow, and LWC to be persisted asynchronously into Log Entry records. Key attributes include Subject, Level, Source, Tags, Records, Body, Is Exception, Stack Trace, Governor Limits, and User. Commonly used for decoupled logging and external event streaming.
CustomObject.label: Log Event
